faq.q: Which country is right for me?
faq.a: It depends on your course, budget and career plans. Your counsellor compares the options with you on the call.

faq.q: How do I choose a university?
faq.a: Your counsellor compares universities on your marks, course, budget and city preferences and gives you a personal shortlist.
Many universities ask for a test score such as IELTS or PTE; some accept other proof. Your counsellor will check what your chosen universities accept.
Tuition and living costs vary widely by country, university and city. Your counsellor will walk you through realistic costs.
Yes — your counsellor will list scholarships you may be eligible for. Scholarships are decided by the universities and are not guaranteed.
Usually academic transcripts, a passport, an English test result (if required), a statement of purpose and references. You get a checklist for your shortlist.

faq.q: Can I visit the Mumbai office?
faq.a: Yes — book your call first and your counsellor will arrange a time to meet at the Mumbai branch.

faq.q: What happens after I submit an enquiry?
faq.a: A counsellor from our Mumbai branch calls you on WhatsApp to understand your goals and plan the next steps.
